extDescription.message: Saves the current page URL or screenshot to Poznote, as a new note or at the end of an existing one.

connectText.message: Link the extension to your Poznote instance once, then save any page in one click.

lostAccessText.message: The extension lost access to your Poznote instance. Reconnect it to keep saving pages.

modeNewTitle.message: Save the page as a new note

modeAppendTitle.message: Add the page at the end of a note

screenshotTitle.message: Save the link with a screenshot of the visible page

pickNote.message: Pick the note to add the page to.

optionsIntro.message: Save the pages you visit to your Poznote instance.

appPasswordHint.message: Create one in Poznote under $1. It reaches the API only and can be revoked at any time. Your account password works too.

footerConnected.message: You are all set: click the Poznote icon in the toolbar on any page to save it.

footerNotConnected.message: Once connected, click the Poznote icon in the toolbar on any page to save it.

unreachable.message: Could not reach $1. Check the address and that the instance is running.

noInstance.message: No Poznote instance answers at $1. Check the address.

fillAddressFirst.message: Fill in your Poznote address first.

fillAllFields.message: Fill in the address, your username and the app password.

waitingAccess.message: Waiting for access to your instance...

accessDenied.message: The extension needs access to $1 to save pages. Click Connect again and choose Allow.

noAccount.message: No account named $1 on this instance.

lostAccessOptions.message: The extension lost access to your instance. Click Connect to allow it again.

unsupportedNoteType.message: Pages can only be added to HTML or Markdown notes.

noteChanged.message: The note changed meanwhile, try again.

noteKeepsChanging.message: The note keeps changing, try again in a moment.
